title: Quenched Chewy Ukrainian Peanut Cookies Kissed Stew
description: A chewy, mustardy stew featuring peanut cookies and Ukrainian flair. Perfect for adventurous eaters and those seeking a high-protein dish.
instructions: Preheat the kazán-cauldron over medium heat.
Add the peanut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the beef stew meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the mustard, tomato paste, chicken broth, bay leaves, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.
Add the peanut cookies and cook, uncovered, until they have absorbed some of the liquid and are slightly softened, about 5 minutes.
Remove the bay leaves and serve the stew hot, garnished with additional peanut cookies if desired.
